121:     def issecure(self, url):
122:         return parse.urlparse(url).scheme == 'https'
123: 
124:     def getBaseUrl(self, redirect_unencrypted=False):
125:         ipAndPort = parse.urlparse(cherrypy.url()).netloc
126:         is_secure_connection = self.issecure(cherrypy.url())
127:         ssl_enabled = cherry.config['server.ssl_enabled']
128:         if ssl_enabled and not is_secure_connection:
129:             log.d('Not secure, redirecting...')
130:             ip = ipAndPort[:ipAndPort.rindex(':')]
131:             url = 'https://' + ip + ':' + str(cherry.config['server.ssl_port'])
132:             if redirect_unencrypted:
133:                 raise cherrypy.HTTPRedirect(url, 302)
134:         else:
135:             url = 'http://' + ipAndPort
136:         return url

138:     def index(self, *args, **kwargs):
139:         self.getBaseUrl(redirect_unencrypted=True)
140:         firstrun = 0 == self.userdb.getUserCount()
141:         if debug:
142:             #reload pages everytime in debig mode
143:             self.mainpage = readRes('res/main.html')
144:             self.loginpage = readRes('res/login.html')
145:             self.firstrunpage = readRes('res/firstrun.html')
146:         if 'login' in kwargs:
147:             username = kwargs.get('username', '')
148:             password = kwargs.get('password', '')
149:             login_action = kwargs.get('login', '')
150:             if login_action == 'login':
151:                 self.session_auth(username, password)
152:                 if cherrypy.session['username']:
153:                     username = cherrypy.session['username']
154:                     log.i('user %s just logged in.' % username)
155:             elif login_action == 'create admin user':
156:                 if firstrun:
157:                     if username.strip() and password.strip():
158:                         self.userdb.addUser(username, password, True)
159:                         self.session_auth(username, password)
160:                         return self.mainpage
161:                 else:
162:                     return "No, you can't."
163:         if firstrun:
164:             return self.firstrunpage
165:         else:
166:             if self.isAuthorized():
167:                 return self.mainpage
168:             else:
169:                 return self.loginpage

172:     def isAuthorized(self):
173:         try:
174:             sessionUsername = cherrypy.session.get('username', None)
175:             sessionUserId = cherrypy.session.get('userid', -1)
176:             nameById = self.userdb.getNameById(sessionUserId)
177:         except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError) as e:
178:             # workaround for python2/python3 jump, filed bug in cherrypy
179:             # https://bitbucket.org/cherrypy/cherrypy/issue/1216/sessions-python2-3-compability-unsupported
180:             log.w('''
181: Dropping all sessions! Try not to change between python 2 and 3,
182: everybody has to relogin now.''')
183:             cherrypy.session.delete()
184:             sessionUsername = None
185:         if not sessionUsername:
186:             return self.autoLoginIfPossible()
187:         elif sessionUsername != nameById:
188:             self.api_logout(value=None)
189:             return False
190:         return True

192:     def autoLoginIfPossible(self):
193:         is_loopback = cherrypy.request.remote.ip in ('127.0.0.1', '::1')
194:         if is_loopback and cherry.config['server.localhost_auto_login']:
195:             cherrypy.session['username'] = self.userdb.getNameById(1)
196:             cherrypy.session['userid'] = 1
197:             cherrypy.session['admin'] = True
198:             return True

201:     def session_auth(self, username, password):
202:         user = self.userdb.auth(username, password)
203:         allow_remote = cherry.config['server.permit_remote_admin_login']
204:         is_loopback = cherrypy.request.remote.ip in ('127.0.0.1', '::1')
205:         if not is_loopback and user.isadmin and not allow_remote:
206:             log.i('Rejected remote admin login from user: %s' % user.name)
207:             user = userdb.User.nobody()
208:         cherrypy.session['username'] = user.name
209:         cherrypy.session['userid'] = user.uid
210:         cherrypy.session['admin'] = user.isadmin

220:     def trans(self, *args):
221:         if not self.isAuthorized():
222:             raise cherrypy.HTTPRedirect(self.getBaseUrl(), 302)
223:         cherrypy.session.release_lock()
224:         if cherry.config['media.transcode'] and len(args):
225:             newformat = args[-1][4:]  # get.format
226:             path = os.path.sep.join(args[:-1])
227:             """ugly workaround for #273, should be handled somewhere in
228:             cherrypy, but don't know where...
229:             """
230:             if sys.version_info < (3, 0):
231:                 path = path
232:             else:
233:                 path = codecs.decode(codecs.encode(path, 'latin1'), 'utf-8')
234:             fullpath = os.path.join(cherry.config['media.basedir'], path)
235:             transcoder = audiotranscode.AudioTranscode()
236:             mimetype = transcoder.mimeType(newformat)
237:             cherrypy.response.headers["Content-Type"] = mimetype
238:             return transcoder.transcodeStream(fullpath, newformat)
239:     trans.exposed = True
240:     trans._cp_config = {'response.stream': True}

242:     def api(self, *args, **kwargs):
243:         """calls the appropriate handler from the handlers
244:         dict, if available. handlers having noauth set to
245:         true do not need authentification to work.
246:         """
247:         #check action
248:         action = args[0] if args else ''
249:         if not action in self.handlers:
250:             return "Error: no such action."
251:         #authorize if not explicitly deactivated
252:         handler = self.handlers[action]
253:         needsAuth = not ('noauth' in dir(handler) and handler.noauth)
254:         if needsAuth and not self.isAuthorized():
255:             raise cherrypy.HTTPError(401, 'Unauthorized')
256:         #parse value (is list of arguments, but if the list has only
257:         #one element, this element is directly passed to the handler)
258:         value = kwargs.get('value', '')
259:         if not value and len(args) > 1:
260:             value = list(map(unquote, args[1:len(args)]))
261:             if len(value) == 1:
262:                 value = value[0]
263:         return handler(value)
264:     api.exposed = True

341:     def download_check_files(self, filelist):
342:         # only admins and allowed users may download
343:         if not cherrypy.session['admin']:
344:             uo = self.useroptions.forUser(self.getUserId())
345:             if not uo.getOptionValue('media.may_download'):
346:                 return 'not_permitted'
347:         # make sure nobody tries to escape from basedir
348:         for f in filelist:
349:             if '/../' in f:
350:                 return 'invalid_file'
351:         # make sure all files are smaller than maximum download size
352:         size_limit = cherry.config['media.maximum_download_size']
353:         if self.model.file_size_within_limit(filelist, size_limit):
354:             return 'ok'
355:         else:
356:             return 'too_big'
357: 
358:     def api_downloadcheck(self, value):
359:         filelist = [unquote(filepath) for filepath in json.loads(value)]
360:         status = self.download_check_files(filelist)
361:         if status == 'not_permitted':
362:             return """You are not allowed to download files."""
363:         elif status == 'invalid_file':
364:             return """Error: File has invalid filename""" % f
365:         elif status == 'too_big':
366:             size_limit = cherry.config['media.maximum_download_size']
367:             return """Can't download: Playlist is bigger than %s mB.
368:             The server administrator can change this configuration.
369:             """ % (size_limit/1024/1024)
370:         elif status == 'ok':
371:             return status
372:         else:
373:             log.e("Unknown download file check status '%s'" % status)
374:             return 'error'
375: 
376:     def download(self, value):
377:         if not self.isAuthorized():
378:             raise cherrypy.HTTPError(401, 'Unauthorized')
379:         filelist = [unquote(filepath) for filepath in json.loads(value)]
380:         dlstatus = self.download_check_files(filelist)
381:         if dlstatus == 'ok':
382:             cherrypy.session.release_lock()
383:             zipmime = 'application/x-zip-compressed'
384:             cherrypy.response.headers["Content-Type"] = zipmime
385:             zipname = 'attachment; filename="music.zip"'
386:             cherrypy.response.headers['Content-Disposition'] = zipname
387:             basedir = cherry.config['media.basedir']
388:             fullpath_filelist = [os.path.join(basedir, f) for f in filelist]
389:             return zipstream.ZipStream(fullpath_filelist)
390:         else:
391:             return dlstatus
392:     download.exposed = True
393:     download._cp_config = {'response.stream': True}

395:     def invert(self, htmlcolor):
396:         r, g, b = self.html2rgb(htmlcolor)
397:         return '#'+self.rgb2hex(255-r, 255-b, 255-b)
398: 
399:     def brightness(self, htmlcolor, brightness):
400:         r, g, b = self.html2rgb(htmlcolor)
401:         r = min(max(r+brightness, 0), 255)
402:         g = min(max(g+brightness, 0), 255)
403:         b = min(max(b+brightness, 0), 255)
404:         return '#'+self.rgb2hex(r, g, b)
405: 
406:     def html2rgb(self, htmlcolor):
407:         r = int(htmlcolor[1:3], 16)
408:         g = int(htmlcolor[3:5], 16)
409:         b = int(htmlcolor[5:7], 16)
410:         return r, g, b
411: 
412:     def rgb2hex(self, r, g, b):
413:         r = hex(r)[2:].zfill(2)
414:         g = hex(g)[2:].zfill(2)
415:         b = hex(b)[2:].zfill(2)
416:         return r+g+b

446:     def api_fetchalbumart(self, value):
447:         cherrypy.session.release_lock()
448:         params = json.loads(value)
449:         directory = params['directory']
450: 
451:         #try getting a cached album art image
452:         b64imgpath = albumArtFilePath(directory)
453:         img_data = self.albumartcache_load(b64imgpath)
454:         if img_data:
455:             cherrypy.response.headers["Content-Length"] = len(img_data)
456:             return img_data
457: 
458:         #try getting album art inside local folder
459:         fetcher = albumartfetcher.AlbumArtFetcher()
460:         localpath = os.path.join(cherry.config['media.basedir'], directory)
461:         header, data, resized = fetcher.fetchLocal(localpath)
462: 
463:         if header:
464:             if resized:
465:                 #cache resized image for next time
466:                 self.albumartcache_save(b64imgpath, data)
467:             cherrypy.response.headers.update(header)
468:             return data
469:         elif cherry.config['media.fetch_album_art']:
470:             #fetch album art from online source
471:             album = os.path.basename(directory)
472:             artist = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(directory))
473:             keywords = artist+' '+album
474:             log.i("Fetching album art for keywords '%s'" % keywords)
475:             header, data = fetcher.fetch(keywords)
476:             if header:
477:                 cherrypy.response.headers.update(header)
478:                 self.albumartcache_save(b64imgpath, data)
479:                 return data
480:         cherrypy.HTTPRedirect("/res/img/folder.png", 302)
